essence: The opening sequence enumerates brahmā, nārāyaṇa, viṣṇu, nṛsiṃha, and one possessing vāsudeva.
The sequence extends with three rāmas, buddha, and kalki, beginning from the earth.
A range extending from earth to śiva is indicated in association with the named figures.
The enumeration includes īśāna, dhanada, bhīma, and the rudras, with markers beginning with mārga in kārtika.
Prakṛti, puruṣa, śakti, and śiva are stated to be situated like the sun and Rudra.
